public_rationale: The available account establishes reported heavy token consumption, not permission to consume $130,000 per month. It also concerns an earlier period. Neither a matching allowance nor a lower enforced cap was established.
limitations: The accessible contextual account is secondary.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic allows Claude Code chief Boris Cherny to burn upwards of $130,000 a month in tokens.

statement.excerpt: Pretty convenient for a guy who’s allowed to burn upwards of $130,000 a month in tokens by Anthropic.

our_interpretation: The claim concerns Boris Cherny's permitted usage, not his personal payments.
The linked sourcing treats token consumption as an estimated retail API-price equivalent. I do not read this as Anthropic's actual infrastructure cost.
I use May 2026, the latest completed month before publication, for the ongoing monthly allowance.
Support requires permission for approximately $130,000 or more per month. Lower observed consumption alone would not contradict an allowance.
criteria.support_condition: A dated company statement, permission record, or credible account establishes that Anthropic permitted Cherny monthly token usage worth approximately $130,000 or more on the stated valuation basis during May 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish an enforced monthly allowance below approximately $130,000 during May 2026.
